intent: A Sunken Shelf corsair's court gown of salt sailcloth, teal-sashed with a shell at the throat, its brass-edged flounced skirt raised to the lower shin over salt stockings, reading from the high camera as a narrow ivory top over a wide, soft bell.
requests: A frustum (a cone, or a cylinder with unequal end diameters) to give the skirt flounces a true slope; the blocky flanges still read as thin ledges from the high camera.
